कॉफी विद करण के नए प्रोमो में कियारा और सिद्धार्थ ने खोली दिल की बात! ☕🔥

1. शो के नए प्रोमो में कियारा अडवाणी और सिद्धार्थ मल्होत्रा ने अपनी शादी और मैरिड लाइफ पर खुलकर बात की। 🛋️
2. कियारा ने खुलासा किया कि उनकी शादी में करण जौहर के साथ स्टेज पर शाहिद कपूर भी परफॉर्मेंस दे रहे थे, लेकिन बाद में करण ने शाहिद को स्टेज से धक्का देकर हटा दिया था।
3. जब करण ने पूछा कि क्या वे घर में कोई फिल्मी किरदार लाते हैं, तो सिद्धार्थ ने मज़ाकिया अंदाज़ में कहा कि वे काम घर या बेडरूम में नहीं लाना चाहते।
4. डेट नाइट्स को लेकर कियारा ने बताया कि उनका प्लान सिर्फ डिनर पर ही खत्म हो जाता है।
5. दोनों की लव स्टोरी फिल्म Shershaah से शुरू हुई थी और उन्होंने 7 फरवरी 2023 को सूर्यगढ़ पैलेस, जैसलमेर में शादी की थी, और अब वे अपने दूसरे बच्चे की उम्मीद कर रहे हैं। 🤰

ctx.title: Kiara Advani reveals Karan Johar threw Shahid Kapoor off stage during her wedding with Sidharth Malhotra in new Koffee With Karan promo
ctx.summary: Kiara Advani and Sidharth Malhotra are set to appear on Koffee With Karan for the first time since announcing that they are expecting their second child.
ctx.text:
The new promo of Koffee With Karan is out, and the next guests on Karan Johar’s celebrity chat show will be Kiara Advani and Sidharth Malhotra. The promo offers a glimpse of their conversation with Karan, as they talk about their wedding, married life and how they keep the romance alive.
In the promo, Kiara and Sidharth discuss their wedding, with Karan calling it "so special". Kiara recalls how Shahid Kapoor joined Karan on stage to give him company while he was performing at the wedding. However, she reveals that the filmmaker eventually threw Shahid off the stage.
The conversation then takes a cheekier turn when Karan asks the couple about the 'roles they play off-screen' and whether they bring any particular characters into their personal lives. Sidharth responds with a witty remark. He says, "We don't want to bring work home and definitely not into our bedroom."
Karan also asks the couple what they do to ensure their date nights do not end at dinner. Kiara, who is expecting her second child with Sidharth, places a hand on her baby bump and responds, "Bas ab humara, we wrap it up at dinner."
The makers shared the post with the caption, “Their Koffee manifestations came true, and now there’s a whole new chapter to catch up on.”
A post shared by JioHotstar Reality (@jiohotstarreality)
In KWK Season 7 in 2022, Karan played a clip for Sidharth from Kiara Advani's episode, where she admitted they were "more than close friends". When pressed about marriage during that episode, Sidharth smiled and shared that he was "manifesting a happier and brighter future."
Kiara and Sidharth grew closer while working on Shershaah. The 2021 film featured Sidharth as Captain Vikram Batra and Kiara as Dimple Cheema, his love interest. The couple kept their relationship largely private before tying the knot on February 7, 2023, in an intimate wedding ceremony at Suryagarh Palace in Jaisalmer, Rajasthan.
During her appearance on Koffee With Karan Season 8, Kiara revealed that Sidharth proposed to her during a family holiday in Rome. She also recalled how he recreated a dialogue from Shershaah while proposing.
In February 2025, the couple announced that they were expecting their first child. They welcomed a baby girl, Saraayah Malhotra, in July 2025. On October 7, 2026, they announced that they were expecting their second child.

Though she holds a Commerce degree, she discovered her true calling in journalism after enrolling at the Indian Institute of Mass Communication (IIMC). She began her career covering Delhi's cultural scene, food, nightlife, concerts, and city life at The Times of India, before moving into full-time entertainment journalism with India Today.

At India Today, Vibha interviewed some of the biggest names in Bollywood and television while carving a niche for herself through film reviews, opinion pieces, nostalgic features, celebrity interviews, and trend-driven stories. She later brought her storytelling and editorial expertise to The Indian Express, where she continued to deepen her understanding of cinema through long-form entertainment explainers, retrospectives and feature writing.
